name: Scanning Transmission Electron Microscopy Analysis Detail
abstract: Detail block for STEM hasPart items. Image pixel size and image dimensions are the only properties both laboratories record, and the pixel size appears in m, nm and um, so it needs normalising before values are compared.

examples.title: detail example HF5000
examples.content: detail instance derived from ADA n=365 | Maizey, Beau | University of Arizona | Hitachi HF5000 (25 instrumentMetadata exports).

examples.title: detail example P1
examples.content: detail instance derived from ADA n=694 | no named analyst | Lawrence Berkeley National Laboratory | FEI TitanX TEM (78 instrumentMetadata exports, dimensions only).

annotatedSchema:
$schema: https://json-schema.org/draft/2020-12/schema
title: Scanning Transmission Electron Microscopy Analysis Detail
description: Detail block for STEM hasPart items. Image pixel size and image dimensions
  are the only properties both laboratories record, and the pixel size appears in
  m, nm and um, so it needs normalising before values are compared.
allOf:
- type: object
  properties:
    ada:componentType:
      anyOf:
      - const: ada:STEMImage
      - const: ada:STEMEDSCube
      - const: ada:STEMEELSCube
      - const: ada:STEMEDSTabular
      - const: ada:STEMEELSTabular
      - const: ada:STEMEDSTomo
    schema:measurementTechnique:
      type: array
      items:
        type: object
        description: '@id reference to a registered stemTAPP TAPP definition.'
        properties:
          '@id':
            type: string
            format: uri
        required:
        - '@id'
    ada:sessionIdentifier:
      description: "Identifier for the analytical session this record describes \u2014
        the laboratory's own run, sequence or batch identifier as generated by the
        instrument or acquisition software. Distinct from any persistent identifier
        a repository mints on submission."
      type: string
    ada:analyst:
      description: Name(s) of the analyst(s) who performed the analysis session. ORCID
        is recommended for persistent identification.
      type: string
    ada:analysisStartDate:
      description: 'Date on which the analytical session began. For sessions spanning
        multiple days, use the date of the first session. Format: YYYY-MM-DD.'
      type: string
    ada:analysisEndDate:
      description: 'Date on which the analytical session ended. May equal Analysis
        Start Date for single-day sessions. Format: YYYY-MM-DD.'
      type: string
    ada:fundingSourceForAnalysis:
      description: Grants and other funding sources that supported the specific sample
        analyses and data collection reported here. Include grant numbers and funding
        agencies. Distinct from procedure development funding, which may have been
        awarded years earlier.
      type: string
    ada:sampleName:
      description: "Name or identifier of each sample analysed in this session, as
        used in the laboratory \u2014 a sample mount, section or aliquot counts as
        one entry where that is what the laboratory tracks. Should match the identifier
        used in associated publications or data tables."
      type: string
    ada:samplingUnitName:
      description: "The name or label of each sampling unit analysed in this session,
        as the laboratory records it, together with the sample it belongs to \u2014
        e.g. a spot number, a grain label, a map or region-of-interest name, or an
        aliquot identifier. Where units are too numerous to name individually, such
        as map pixels or reconstructed voxels, name the acquisition area they belong
        to instead."
      type: string
    ada:magnification:
      description: Nominal magnification.
      anyOf:
      - type: number
      - type: string
    ada:dwellTimePerProbePosition:
      description: Dwell time per scanned probe position.
      anyOf:
      - type: number
      - type: string
    ada:cameraLength:
      description: Camera length.
      anyOf:
      - type: number
      - type: string
    ada:stageXPosition:
      description: Stage X position.
      anyOf:
      - type: number
      - type: string
    ada:stageYPosition:
      description: Stage Y position.
      anyOf:
      - type: number
      - type: string
    ada:stageTiltAlpha:
      description: Primary stage tilt.
      anyOf:
      - type: number
      - type: string
    ada:stageTiltBeta:
      description: Secondary stage tilt.
      anyOf:
      - type: number
      - type: string
    ada:imagePixelSize:
      description: Physical size of one image pixel.
      anyOf:
      - type: number
      - type: string
    ada:imageWidth:
      description: Image width in pixels.
      anyOf:
      - type: integer
      - type: string
    ada:imageHeight:
      description: Image height in pixels.
      anyOf:
      - type: integer
      - type: string
  required:
  - ada:componentType
  - ada:sessionIdentifier
  - ada:analyst
  - ada:analysisStartDate
  - ada:analysisEndDate
  - ada:fundingSourceForAnalysis
  - ada:sampleName
  - ada:samplingUnitName
  - ada:magnification
  - ada:dwellTimePerProbePosition
  - ada:cameraLength
  - ada:stageXPosition
  - ada:stageYPosition
  - ada:stageTiltAlpha
  - ada:stageTiltBeta
  - ada:imagePixelSize
  - ada:imageWidth
  - ada:imageHeight
- type: object
  properties:
    schema:additionalProperty:
      type: array
      description: Per-dataset schema:PropertyValue entries. All optional.
      items:
        anyOf:
        - $ref: https://amds-ldeo.github.io/geochemBuildingBlocks/build/annotated/registry/parameterValues/schema.yaml#/$defs/stem_coupledProcedureDoi
        - $ref: https://amds-ldeo.github.io/geochemBuildingBlocks/build/annotated/registry/parameterValues/schema.yaml#/$defs/stem_coupledDatasetOrPublicationReference
        - $ref: https://amds-ldeo.github.io/geochemBuildingBlocks/build/annotated/registry/parameterValues/schema.yaml#/$defs/stem_samplePersistentIdentifier
        - $ref: https://amds-ldeo.github.io/geochemBuildingBlocks/build/annotated/registry/parameterValues/schema.yaml#/$defs/stem_samplePreparationMethod
        - $ref: https://amds-ldeo.github.io/geochemBuildingBlocks/build/annotated/registry/parameterValues/schema.yaml#/$defs/stem_samplingUnitSelectionCriteria
        - $ref: https://amds-ldeo.github.io/geochemBuildingBlocks/build/annotated/registry/parameterValues/schema.yaml#/$defs/stem_preAnalysisImagingAndScreening
        - $ref: https://amds-ldeo.github.io/geochemBuildingBlocks/build/annotated/registry/parameterValues/schema.yaml#/$defs/stem_dataProcessingSoftware
        - $ref: https://amds-ldeo.github.io/geochemBuildingBlocks/build/annotated/registry/parameterValues/schema.yaml#/$defs/stem_calibrationFactorAndDeterminationMethod
        - $ref: https://amds-ldeo.github.io/geochemBuildingBlocks/build/annotated/registry/parameterValues/schema.yaml#/$defs/stem_constantsAndReferenceValuesUsed
        - type: object
          description: Catch-all for additional schema:PropertyValue entries beyond
            the stemTAPP-derived catalog.
          properties:
            '@type':
              type: array
              items:
                type: string
              contains:
                const: schema:PropertyValue
            schema:propertyID:
              type: object
              required:
              - '@id'
              properties:
                '@id':
                  type: string
                  not:
                    enum:
                    - ada:parameter/stemTAPP/coupledProcedureDoi
                    - ada:parameter/stemTAPP/coupledDatasetOrPublicationReference
                    - ada:parameter/stemTAPP/samplePersistentIdentifier
                    - ada:parameter/stemTAPP/samplePreparationMethod
                    - ada:parameter/stemTAPP/samplingUnitSelectionCriteria
                    - ada:parameter/stemTAPP/preAnalysisImagingAndScreening
                    - ada:parameter/stemTAPP/dataProcessingSoftware
                    - ada:parameter/stemTAPP/calibrationFactorAndDeterminationMethod
                    - ada:parameter/stemTAPP/constantsAndReferenceValuesUsed
          required:
          - '@type'
          - schema:propertyID
